intro: Making Our Move is a coordinated tactical assault against the hostile Al'Aketh entrenched within the Shrine of Akir. By utilizing a frontal distraction and an flanking maneuver, the strike force seeks to breach the defenses and reach the High Priestess.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Everyone is here, good. I've just sent a few of my best fighters in through the front of the shrine to cause a bit of trouble and serve as a distraction, while I lead the the bulk of our forces in from the flank.

If all goes well, we should be able to punch through quickly and take out the High Priestess. As for you, get in there and start cracking skulls. Meet my second, Hyusaa Quickbreeze, near the steps to the shrine after you've caused some trouble.

clips.title: Completion
paras: We fought hard to get this far but it isn't over yet.
